Select the first 1000 activity rows for human single-protein target CHEMBL3706 (Disintegrin and metalloproteinase domain-containing protein 17) with IC50 measurements and pChEMBL values. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL3706, target_type SINGLE PROTEIN, tax_id 9606, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and pchembl_value not null. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Order by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
